description: Convert a SWIFT MT940 customer statement into an ISO 20022 camt.053.001.08 bank statement, for banks and systems still on MT. Reads bare MT940 or SWIFT blocks, several statements per file, balances (:60F:/:60M:, :62F:/:62M:, :64:, :65:), every :61: line (dates, debit/credit, reversals, amount, transaction type, both references) and :86: in SWIFT keyword, German ?-subfield or free-text layout (end-to-end reference, mandate, counterparty and IBAN, remittance text). Checks the MT940 adds up (opening plus entries equals closing), then runs the camt.053 through the Test Bench. Returns the XML, ready for reconcile_statement. Exact decimals; nothing is stored. Same code as https://iomarkets.tech/convert. Pass sample: true for a built-in demo statement.

mt940.description: The MT940 text (starting with :20:, or SWIFT blocks {1:…}{4:…-}).

sample.description: Ignore mt940 and convert the built-in sample (a made-up EUR account, the same day as reconcile_statement's sample).

name: convert_mt940
title: Convert an MT940 statement to camt.053
